cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario launch-running --motion paused --frame 299 --color truecolor at 120×40. for_scenario in src/bin/jackin/app.rs sets world.clock.running false when motion is Paused. start sends Go::Launch with LaunchPlan::Clean, workspace Some(1), role the-architect, agent Claude Code, and account acct-claude-work, then seeks the cockpit by frame. LaunchEvent::Ready in src/bin/jackin/screens/cockpit.rs sets activity Hardline open · handing off to the Capsule, pushes one Running instance from instance_record, and Go::Attach. Go::Attach, while route() is still Cockpit, sets handoff to Some(0). Motion is not Reduced, so it does not call finish_handoff. route() is Route::Handoff while handoff is Some. on_tick advances that counter only while clock.running, so the frame stays handoff_stage(0), CockpitDim(1), from src/bin/jackin/rain.rs. It shows 3 running and jackin-payments-platform-b5df. sequence_key on Route::Handoff calls finish_handoff for Enter and for Esc. finish_handoff clears handoff and enters the capsule. Neither key pushes another instance: detach shows 3 running, b5df · payments-platform, and no b5e0. A separate --motion full launch plays all HANDOFF_LEN ticks (12) and then finish_handoff. That capsule is still the one launched instance.

cases.return_path: Enter or Esc finishes the paused handoff into the capsule of b5df; Ctrl+B d detaches to an inventory of 3 running

cases.disposition_reason: The case records scenario null. --scenario launch-running is the entry path. start in src/bin/jackin/app.rs opens LaunchPlan::Clean. LaunchEvent::Ready in src/bin/jackin/screens/cockpit.rs pushes one Running record from instance_record. new_instance_id in src/bin/jackin/sim/world.rs names that record jk-b5df for this fixture; the next push would be jk-b5e0. Go::Attach in src/bin/jackin/app.rs, while the route is still Cockpit and motion is Reduced, sets handoff to Some(0) and calls finish_handoff immediately. There is no fade frame. finish_handoff clears handoff and enters Route::Capsule. The checkpoints are that capsule after the pane reaches Allow edit to src/settlement/config.rs, at 120×40 and then at 80×24 after resize(80, 24), before resize(120, 40) and before detach. The wide frame shows payments-platform › the-architect, 1 Claude Code (Work), feature/settlement-backoff, and needs input. cases.action_sequence: Under --motion reduced, capture the capsule at 120×40, resize to 80×24, capture it, resize back to 120×40, then detach. On separate launches, skip a paused handoff with Enter and with Esc, and finish a full-motion handoff.
cases.expected_results: The capsule is the one launched instance, jk-b5df. Reduced motion skips the fade. Enter, Esc, and the full-motion finish leave the running count at 3.
cases.forbidden_effects: Skip or finish pushes a second instance. The reduced checkpoints show a fade frame or a Launch failed dialog.
